integrity: Two standalone exact whole-space proof programs reproduced all first-entry histograms and all orbit-basin size multiplicities. Recurrent classification by earlier work is acknowledged and not represented as a general new theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact theorem only for T(6) and KG(6,2), with incumbent-tie synchronous majority; no generalization to other orders or update rules. Historical priority remains conditional on unindexed literature and the inaccessible full text of one relevant recurrent-classification article.
title: Complementary fifteen-site majority networks have distinct exact attraction-basin spectra
